title: Revision filed under the first route
body: The map carries two route lines. The lower one is marked final even though the upper line says road closed. A lunchbox beside it contains one untouched sandwich and a form folded around the old line.
rival_reading: An agricultural access plan could be revised after a closure and leave an earlier copy underneath; the filing order alone does not show a failed evacuation.
gloss: A final route revision sits over an older closure instruction while the meal is untouched.

title: The plot had a receipt, not a source
body: The bucket’s rim is chalked with a plot number. On the clipboard, the amount delivered is signed, but the source box is crossed out and replaced with ‘see field.’ A half-eaten sandwich is tucked under the clip.
rival_reading: Officials could sign for field supplies during a containment response and leave the source for later review; the missing source does not prove an agricultural malfunction.
gloss: A signed field delivery has a plot number but no source, with a worker’s meal left in the paperwork.
